name: Penetration-model validation
mitigation: Instrumented cold ice/rock impact trials spanning geometry, obliquity and fracture; fit dynamic force law.

name: Sandstone depth without breakup
mitigation: Demonstrate >=1.5 m in representative competent sandstone; consider drilling or lower burial depth.

name: Probe attitude at impact
mitigation: 6-DOF aero/spin testing, spin stabilization or fins; validate angle and tumble envelope.

name: Drogue deployment envelope
mitigation: Mach-q deployment map, inflation loads, subscale low-density testing and opening shock.

name: Deorbit targeting & guidance
mitigation: Propagate finite burn + J2 + atmospheric dispersions; tie orbit and entry states with navigation covariance.

name: Thermal-protection sizing
mitigation: CFD and radiative aeroheating, FIAT/PATO thermal response, bondline/temp/soak margin and arcjet tests.

name: Penetrator instrument survival
mitigation: Qualification shock spectra and pulse width; potting, staking, encapsulated die, strain relief and functional re-test.

name: Battery impact and cold operation
mitigation: Custom-cased primary cells, current-limited harness, shock+thermal testing and isolation after impact.

name: 45 kg mass closure
mitigation: Detailed TPS/structure/dispenser/chutes/power budgets with growth margin; charge propulsion to proper stage.

name: Buried communications link
mitigation: Test UHF attenuation through wet/dry/ice strata; use surface antenna/aftbody linked by impact-rated tether.

name: Release separation collisions
mitigation: Coupled six-body dispersions and actuator energy/timing with 6-DOF wake interaction.

name: Site surface heterogeneity
mitigation: High-resolution terrain maps and prior orbital spectroscopy; model rocks, layers, regolith and ice.

name: Dynamic stability after releases
mitigation: Time-varying mass/CG/inertia and aerodynamic stability through all six separations.

name: Planetary protection classification
mitigation: Obtain formal Mars category and special-region/site concurrence before design freeze; define biological/organic contamination limits, assays and documentation.

name: Power after cold cruise
mitigation: Storage, battery activation and heater budgeting over 5–7 month cruise and descent.

name: Thermal structural interface
mitigation: Thermomechanical bondline stress, ply/tile joints and heat-shield release qualification.

name: Attached canopy on surface impact
mitigation: Impact with flight-representative attached inflated chute: quantify riser torque, canopy collapse, line snagging, line severance, impact attitude, and burial obstruction.

name: Higher velocity at 4 kg
mitigation: Retest 4 kg flight-like shape at target speeds in cryogenic ice and competent sandstone; verify structural margins.

name: Aeroshell mass transfer allocation
mitigation: Allocate all freed 6 kg to named carrier/TPS hardware; verify attached drogue/retention hardware inside each 4 kg probe mass and close growth allowance.

name: Irradiation versus batteries and electronics
mitigation: Qualify full-assembly processing dose tolerance for battery chemistry, controller TID, memory, sensor calibration, seals, adhesives and potting; functional cold/shock tests after exposure.

name: Shielded embedded bioburden
mitigation: Map minimum and maximum absorbed dose across dense tip, sealed cavities and potted PCB; assay encapsulated bioburden with representative witness/test articles.

name: Recontamination after irradiation
mitigation: Validate clean process handling, sterile barrier, storage, late-test controls, transport and deployment interface integration; document microbiological acceptance.
